speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly what you feel when you touch the skin on the back of your left hand? Is it itchy, painful, or just rough?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old female. The patient is here for an annual well-check. She has a history of well-controlled diabetes and hypertension, managed with metformin and losartan, respectively. She reports maintaining a healthy diet primarily consisting of vegetables and lean meat, denies any tobacco or alcohol use, and enjoys outdoor activities like walking and sunbathing.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. Based on your age, sun exposure history, and the location on your dorsal hand, this is a very likely pre-cancerous skin lesion. I will examine the area closely to confirm the presence of a rough, sandpaper-like texture before we proceed with any treatment options.
